rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts must exist before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task/takeover while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.EXAMPLE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Prepared example IDs remain unique and prior repairs are preserved.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_CORE_DISCOVERY: Feature API landing/conformance/collections/items discovery is capability evidence, not terrain evidence.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_COLLECTION_ID: Collection identity must be established before querying metadata features.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_ITEMS_PATH: Metadata matching must use feature items, not map portrayal.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_DEFAULT_CRS: Default feature CRS semantics must not be confused with native EA raster CRS.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_BBOX_CRS: bbox-crs must be explicit when bbox coordinates are not in the default CRS.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_RESPONSE_CRS: Requested feature response CRS is representation processing, not native observation.
rule_descriptions.FEATURES_INTERNAL_TRANSFORM: Server internal transformation for bbox selection must not be treated as source-survey transform metadata.
rule_descriptions.QUERYABLES_DISCOVERY: Queryable property names/schema must be discovered before attribute filtering.
rule_descriptions.FILTER_EXPRESSION_ROLE: Filter expressions select metadata features; selection alone does not prove composite contribution.
rule_descriptions.FILTER_BBOX_AND: bbox and filter predicates combine logically and all constraints must match.
rule_descriptions.FILTER_DATETIME_AND: datetime and attribute filters must both match when combined.
rule_descriptions.FILTER_CRS: filter-crs must be explicit when spatial literals use a non-default CRS.
rule_descriptions.CQL2_TEXT_JSON: CQL2 Text/JSON are filter encodings, not source-authority evidence.
rule_descriptions.CQL2_SPATIAL: Spatial predicates require explicit geometry/CRS interpretation.
rule_descriptions.CQL2_TEMPORAL: Temporal predicates must use actual survey dates rather than publication dates.
rule_descriptions.CQL2_COMPARISON: Attribute comparison requires correct field semantics and units.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Composite contributing survey remains UNKNOWN until EA metadata-index feature match.
rule_descriptions.EA_SPATIAL_MATCH: Metadata survey footprint must spatially cover the parcel/tile.
rule_descriptions.EA_TEMPORAL_MATCH: Survey date/time metadata must be retained after matching.
rule_descriptions.EA_RESOLUTION_MATCH: Source resolution metadata must be retained and must not be inferred from output resolution.
rule_descriptions.EA_TRANSFORM_MATCH: Survey-specific transform/geoid metadata must be retained.
rule_descriptions.EA_SURVEY_ID_MATCH: Survey/block/phase identity must come from metadata attributes, not filename guesswork.
rule_descriptions.EA_COMPOSITE_POLICY: Newest/best-resolution composite policy is not parcel-specific survey identity.
rule_descriptions.EA_BILINEAR_ROLE: Bilinear resampling is processing and remains explicit.
rule_descriptions.EA_GROUND_TRUTH_ROLE: Ground-truth QC validates surveys but is not a parcel elevation sample.
rule_descriptions.EA_ABS_REL_ERROR: Absolute RMSE and relative/random error remain separate.
rule_descriptions.POINT_DENSITY_ROLE: Point density is not raster cell resolution.
rule_descriptions.DTM_DSM_ROLE: DSM and first-return surfaces are excluded from primary bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_GENERAL_BOUNDARY: General boundary/title-plan red edging is not an exact legal line.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_DETERMINED_BOUNDARY: Exact legal-boundary claims require determined-boundary evidence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_MEASUREMENT_TOL: Boundary-plan horizontal measurement tolerance is not LiDAR vertical RMSE.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_COORD_TOL: Boundary National Grid coordinate tolerance is not terrain height uncertainty.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_CELL_MEAN: Terrain 5 cell mean is secondary and not a 1m point observation.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_PIXEL_CENTER: Terrain 5 pixel-centre convention is not a vertical-accuracy guarantee.
rule_descriptions.OS_TERRAIN5_METADATA: Terrain 5 version/lineage metadata is not parcel acquisition time.
rule_descriptions.CIS_DOMAIN_RANGE: Coverage domain and range structure must remain consistent.
rule_descriptions.REFERENCEABLE_GRID: Referenceable grid must not be assumed rectified/native.
rule_descriptions.WCS_INTERPOLATION: Interpolated WCS output is derived unless explicitly canonical.
rule_descriptions.WCS_CRS: WCS CRS transformed output is not native-grid sampling.
rule_descriptions.WCS_RANGE: Range subsetting changes components, not spatial sampling resolution.
rule_descriptions.NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: No-data/missing/unknown must never be converted to zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing measured 1m/2m parcel values remain unchanged during QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is repository workflow confidence, not universal statistical coverage.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until canonical recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while any required F-host receipt is missing.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo overlay row visibility is not live Chromium acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten under concurrent branch activity.
